developer_response.body:
Hey, we're sorry you didn't have a good experience with our game. However, the cosmetics do work, and the item shop icon is simply outdated and will be updated soon. We're also not entirely sure what you mean by a dash system," as our game doesn't have one.

As for the comparisons, Gandy did not invent nextbots. The concept originally comes from Garry's Mod and was popularized by games like Nico's Nextbots. While we understand the similarities, Those Nextbots is its own project, and we're working hard to improve it with future updates.

We appreciate the feedback regardless!
